rules.name: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "credentials" or Message contains "transmitted" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-001

rules.name: Default Credentials Usage on Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "default" or Message contains "credentials" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-002

rules.name: Account Lockout Mechanism Failure
rules.description: Detects more than 20 failed login attempts for a single account without lockout indicating weak lockout policy
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "account" or Message contains "lockout" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-003

rules.name: Authentication Schema Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass authentication by accessing protected endpoints without valid session tokens
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "authentication" or Message contains "schema" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-004

rules.name: Weak Remember-Me Cookie Detection
rules.description: Detects authentication cookies lacking proper security attributes or containing predictable values
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "weak" or Message contains "remember" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-005

rules.name: Browser Cache Sensitivity — Missing No-Cache Headers
rules.description: Detects responses from sensitive endpoints missing Cache-Control: no-store headers
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "browser" or Message contains "cache" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-006

rules.name: Weak Authentication — Basic Auth Over HTTP
rules.description: Detects HTTP Basic Authentication over unencrypted connections exposing credentials in cleartext
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "weak" or Message contains "authentication" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-007

rules.name: MFA Bypass or Absence for Privileged Accounts
rules.description: Detects privileged operations performed without MFA verification for accounts that require it
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "mfa" or Message contains "bypass" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-008

rules.name: Credential Stuffing Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing patterns with high volume login failures from the same source across multiple accounts
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "credential" or Message contains "stuffing" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-009

rules.name: JWT Algorithm None Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass attempt
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "jwt" or Message contains "algorithm" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-010

rules.name: Directory Traversal Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects path traversal attempts using ../ sequences or encoded variants to access files outside intended directories
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "directory" or Message contains "traversal" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-011

rules.name: Authorization Schema Bypass via Role Manipulation
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass authorization by manipulating role parameters in API requests
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "authorization" or Message contains "schema" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-012

rules.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
rules.description: Detects sequential or predictable resource ID access patterns indicating IDOR vulnerability exploitation
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "insecure" or Message contains "direct" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-013

rules.name: OAuth Token Scope Escalation
rules.description: Detects OAuth token usage where requested scopes exceed granted scopes indicating authorization bypass
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "oauth" or Message contains "token" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-014

rules.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests missing CSRF tokens indicating potential cross-site request forgery
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cross" or Message contains "site" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-015

rules.name: Session Fixation Attack
rules.description: Detects session fixation where a pre-set session ID is accepted by the server after authentication
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "session" or Message contains "fixation" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-016

rules.name: Session Token in URL Parameters
rules.description: Detects session tokens transmitted in URL query strings exposing them to logging and Referer headers
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "session" or Message contains "token" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-017

rules.name: Concurrent Session on Different IPs
rules.description: Detects the same session token being used from different IP addresses simultaneously indicating session hijacking
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "concurrent" or Message contains "session" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-018

rules.name: JWT Token Tampering or Forgery
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with invalid signatures, expired timestamps, or algorithm manipulation
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "jwt" or Message contains "token" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-019

rules.name: Insecure Session Cookie Attributes
rules.description: Detects session cookies missing Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite attributes
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "insecure" or Message contains "session" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-020
